title: Grade 5 Science — Tracing Energy Through Food Webs
subject: Science
description: Practice with questions on producers, consumers, decomposers, interdependence.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: In a grass → rabbit → fox chain, which organism is the producer?
In a pond, algae make their own food with light. What role do they play?
What organisms help recycle nutrients by breaking down dead matter?
What do arrows usually show in a food web?
A hawk eats a snake that eats a mouse. Which is prey of the hawk?
What is the original energy source for most land food webs?
In a grassland web, mice and rabbits eat grasses. What role do mice and rabbits have there?
If leaf-eating caterpillars decline, what may happen to birds that mostly eat those caterpillars?
Which organism could be both a consumer of seeds and prey for an owl?
In algae → snail → fish, what direction does energy move first?
How is a food web different from a single food chain?
choices: It always contains only one animal.
It leaves out what eats what.
It represents multiple connected feeding paths.

questions.question: Which organism is an omnivore?
choices: a raccoon that eats berries and insects
an owl that eats only other animals
a rabbit that eats only grasses

questions.question: Why are decomposers important for plants?
choices: They supply all the world's sunlight.
They remove every organism that eats plants.
They absorb all usable soil nutrients forever.
They return some nutrients to the environment.

questions.question: A fox eats rabbits and mice. Why can having two prey species help the fox?
choices: It no longer needs the web.
It may switch foods if one prey species declines.
It can make its own food from sunlight.
It stops both prey populations from changing.

questions.question: What is one likely effect if many plants die in a meadow?
choices: The meadow gains more sunlight everywhere.
Meat-eating animals no longer depend on other organisms.
Plant-eating animals may have less food.

questions.question: Which order shows energy from food passing through three organisms?
In an ocean web tiny animals eat plantlike plankton. Which organisms directly use sunlight to make food?
choices: fish that eat the tiny animals

questions.question: Which example shows competition in a food web?
choices: A seed sprouts in a cup.
A bird builds its nest from sticks.
Two bird species seek the same limited seeds.

questions.question: If a fish eats insects and a heron eats fish, which change might affect both fish and herons?
choices: the color of a measuring tape
the pattern on a field notebook

questions.question: What would happen to energy input into this land food web if its plants got much less light?
choices: Plants would have less light energy to make food.
Plants would get more energy from darkness.
The amount of light would have no possible effect.
Predators would directly use all the missing light.
